run_behaviour.required_by_other_modules: no module lists CP-L10 as a required or optional input, before or after; edge_rule('CP-5','CP-L10') stays restricted
run_behaviour.idle_statuses: CP-1 is in scope and unrun for a run that requests CP-L10 (in-scope unrun: CP-0, CP-L10 -> CP-0, CP-1, CP-L10)
run_behaviour.readiness_live_consumers: live_consumers(pack) for a run requesting CP-L10: ('CP-L10',) -> ('CP-1', 'CP-L10'); the CP-0 review must assess CP-1 as well as CP-L10 (a CP-L10-only review is refused 'Assess each selected canonical live consumer exactly once')
run_behaviour.cp1_workflow_consumer_entries: CP-1's readiness stage now requests the CP-L10 entry (cp1_workflow.consumer_entries), routed to consumer_specific_review with requirement consumer_specific_cp1_sufficiency; before the edit CP-1 ran with no CP-L10 request
run_behaviour.front_page_cp1_blocks: model-chart-strip, capital-structure, financials-credit-metrics: on the committed report_view (sha256 51a6853e...0e12) CP-1 is a credit_snapshot preset module, so under the CP-L10 override these read not_run `Not run: CP-1 was not requested in this run.` without D4, not_run `Not run: CP-1 has not run.` with D4 and CP-1 unrun, populated once CP-1 settles; render probe in expected.rendered

fact_selection_rule.predicate: fact.table_id == 'T4.10' and fact.label == '<column> · <metric>'; exactly one fact per (column, metric) or the operand is refused as unbound (zero or several matches are not zero or first-wins)
fact_selection_rule.observed: Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4 columns on the real promoted CP-1 head (copy of the S1 positive head, 500 T4.10 facts, no duplicate label; review-precise-1 and the revision-2 probe): ebitda source; fcf calculated; cash_closing source; total_debt source; net_debt calculated; every fact has a `canonical-kpi:` calculation_id; every MILLIONS fact has currency USD and scale 1000000; Q1-Q3 ratio facts status missing, value_class calculated, limitation 'COMPONENT_MISSING; Four complete contiguous quarters spanning 364-371 days are required'; Q4 total_leverage_reported 1.6666666666666666666666666666666666667 and interest_coverage_reported 6, value_class calculated
fact_selection_rule.inferred_not_observed: none: every copied cell (value_class, status, amount, unit, period) was read from the real head
fact_selection_rule.fact_ids: interface-fact:<sha256>; bound at run time, never literal

cp1_readiness.routing: CP-L10 is not in downstream_readiness._DEPENDENCIES (:27-39), so the entry routes to `consumer_specific_review`, requirement `consumer_specific_cp1_sufficiency`; the dependency requirements `cash_flow_metrics` and `liquidity_data` are unknown for CP-L10 and refused

markers.{{INPUTS_SHA256}}: content hash of the step's prefilled DownstreamInputs (consumers replaced by the CP-L10 request)
markers.{{EVID:kpi <K>, quarter <N>}}: evidence_id of the FIRST catalogue record (catalogue order) of kind `kpi` whose record_json key is <K> (ebitda, fcf, cash_closing, total_debt, net_debt) and whose non-empty value.observation_ids all end in `-q<N>-2025`; a record whose observation ids include a later LTM match (Q4 cash, total debt, net debt) is selected by the Q4 observation, not the LTM one. 20 ids: N = 1..4 outer, K in that order inner

cp1_readiness.validator_result: validate_downstream_review: no issues; _assess_consumers row CP-L10 ready_with_limitations, 0 unassessed requirements, 0 unassessed gaps, no blocking gap; probed by review-precise-1 and re-run in revision 2 on this literal with markers bound (revision-2.md)

cp1_calculation_id.rule: a copied TL10.2 cell carries the calculation_id of the CP-1 T4.10 fact named by copied_from_cp1 (canonical-kpi:<sha256>), read at run time; never literal
